## Affected file or section

Name the public showcase file and section.

## What is wrong?

Describe the unclear statement, broken link, or invalid illustrative example.

## Suggested correction

Explain what the documentation should say instead, including any distinction between current and planned work.

## Safe supporting context

Use only public or fictional information. Do not attach production screenshots, logs, credentials, private paths, real communications, client data, or private security findings.

This template is for the public showcase. Use an established private channel with the builder for concerns about the private system.
